verdict.rationale: EBANX documents payment status notifications sent as HTTP POSTs to a configured Notification URL, plus API error responses, so an agent could monitor payment outcomes. Its Recurring Payments solution claims smart retry logic. Agent-driven retry control and dunning outreach are not documented. Missing for 10: explicit failed-payment or decline webhook events, an API for an agent to trigger or configure retries, dunning or customer outreach features, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor failed payments via API and webhooks and drive retries and dunning outreach

citations.quote: EBANX sends an HTTP POST request to the configured Notification URL. The request includes basic payment and status information, along with headers containing a digital signature
Recurring Payments solution that includes local currency and alternative payment method acceptance, unified reconciliation, smart retry logic, tokenized credit card payments
When an error occurs, EBANX responds with a JSON object that includes details about the error, allowing you to understand and address the issue quickly.
